description: Use this when the person attaches a photo of food they ate or will eat. Reads it as the Almost Fire camera does: a plate or bowl comes back as each food with its grams, calories, macros and how sure the read is; a packet as its label per 100 g; a pot on a kitchen scale as its grams. Nothing is logged: read it back, take their corrections, then call log_foods with its logItems (or they tap Log on the card). Do not use for a photo that isn't food, or to judge anyone's body.

note.description: Anything they said about it ("half the rice", "oat flat white").

name: read_meal_photo
title: Read a meal photo
